svg.title: Ordinal: draft, schedule and analyze social posts through Ordinal's MCP server
svg.desc: Inside your agent, the Ordinal capability connects to Ordinal's hosted MCP server at app.tryordinal.com/mcp with an OAuth access token. The model sees the server's tool names unchanged. It starts with ordinal_get_workspace_context, which returns the workspaceSlug every other Ordinal tool needs. Wrapping the toolset with approval_required() pauses calls that publish or schedule posts for review.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
